event: Declined a promotion to regional director in 1998 to stay in her hometown near her aging parents.
Drank a cup of black coffee every morning before writing.
Emigrated from Poland to Canada in 1990, leaving her parents and siblings behind, never to live in the same country as them again.
In her sixties she invested a large share of her retirement fund in her nephew's unproven restaurant venture.
In her thirties she kept all savings in cash and refused to invest, fearing loss.
Left a fast-growing startup in 2012 to care for her husband through his cancer treatment.
Mentions her morning coffee ritual again while describing her writing desk.
Recalls the 1998 promotion she gave up, still sure it was the right choice.
Turned down an overseas transfer to Singapore in 2005 so the children could stay in the same school.
